name: Wonton
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 1

Flavor Profiles texture
Additional Ingredients any

EFFECT

Duration 8 hours; Serving Size 1d8

DESCRIPTION

An wonton is a fried wrapper (eggs, flour, water), rolled and cut into squares, then folded over on itself into a triangle and fried. It can be filled with cheese, meats, or other fillings.

When completed, each wonton counts as a shuriken of your size category that you can throw with proficiency. They can also be consumed to grant a non-magical stabilize effect or 1d8 temporary hit points that last for the duration (chosen when consumed).

Additional ingredients increase the serving size and temporary hit points by +1 each.

Additional salty ingredients allow you to change the damage dealt by the wonton to electricity.

Additional sour ingredients allow you to change the damage dealt by the wonton to acid.

Additional spicy ingredients allow you to change the damage dealt by the wonton to fire.
